scope: Third ten exact records, excluding the first twenty by complete payload, from the immutable 22:21:40 Hermes-trio snapshot. Proposed review only, no apply manifest.
evidence_read: Complete ten selected facts, ten source episode records, all 133 same-episode companion payloads, all ten selected endpoint metadata records; six exact-ID reproduced complete source projections; two complete recorded parent spans with explicit historical chunk-ID limitations; complete available Helm seed; full manual summary. hash_format: expected_sha256 is SHA-256 of production Go json.Marshal(Fact). old_key is the raw Badger fact key with UnixNano timestamp; index_key is search.FactKey with RFC3339Nano. These formats are distinct.
rules: No fact changed/discarded. UNRESOLVED is not an implicit keep or approved relocation. Each reason distinguishes possible ownership from missing relation/status/source evidence. Later store drift must be inventoried separately; this is not a complete trio audit.
